trends.name: Iran Crisis Escalates Oil Markets
trends.summary: US strikes on Iran's Kharg Island (which processes 90% of Iranian oil exports) have sent crude oil above $115/barrel with Trump's ultimatum deadline imminent. Breaking reports indicate stalled peace talks and threats to disrupt regional oil/gas infrastructure and the Strait of Hormuz. This geopolitical shock is the dominant market mover impacting energy stocks, airline costs, and inflation expectations.

trends.name: Fed Signals Higher 2026 Inflation Path
trends.summary: Fed's Williams explicitly warned that Iran war will drive up headline inflation, with his prediction of 2.75% inflation for 2026 now appearing conservative. This real-time Fed commentary signals potential policy recalibration and contradicts market expectations for rate cuts, creating immediate implications for fixed income and equity valuations.

trends.name: Durable Goods Orders Miss Expectations
trends.summary: February durable goods orders fell 1.4% (vs -1.2% expected and 0% prior), signaling weak business investment demand. However, durables ex-transportation and capital goods shipments beat estimates, creating mixed signals about corporate capex health amid geopolitical uncertainty.

trends.name: Broadcom-Google-Anthropic AI Deals Catalyze Chip Rally
trends.summary: Broadcom's stock is rising on significant new deals with Google and Anthropic, signaling continued AI infrastructure spending and semiconductor demand resilience. This validates Goldman Sachs' thesis that tech stocks present a generational buying opportunity despite recent volatility.

trends.name: Airlines Navigate Oil Shock Better Than Expected
trends.summary: Delta raised checked bag fees $10 amid jet fuel surge, but analysts argue US airlines are better positioned for oil shocks than markets believe. Despite near-term margin pressure, operational efficiency gains and hedging strategies provide downside protection vs. historical patterns.

trends.name: Trump Impeachment Odds Surge to 69%
trends.summary: Prediction market pricing shows 69% probability Trump is impeached before 2028, with odds climbing sharply in recent months. This political risk premium is now embedded in markets and could amplify volatility around policy/regulatory decisions.

trends.name: Healthcare Stocks Outperform on Medicare Advantage Clarity
trends.summary: Trump administration finalized better-than-feared Medicare Advantage payment rates, boosting health insurer stocks. Combined with strong earnings growth in sector, healthcare stocks are identified as offering both value and rapid profit expansion in volatile markets.

trends.name: Tech Stocks Offer Generational Buying Opportunity
trends.summary: Goldman Sachs declares current valuations present a generational buying opportunity for US tech stocks. AppLovin's brutal 2026 selloff and Microsoft's recent underperformance are viewed as capitulation events creating attractive entry points for long-term investors.

trends.name: Real Estate Market Disrupted by Iran War Uncertainty
trends.summary: Iran war is upending the spring housing market with agents reporting buyer hesitation. Geopolitical uncertainty is creating unexpected headwinds for real estate activity even as broader economic data suggests business spending resilience.

trends.name: Used Car Prices Hit 3-Year Highs
trends.summary: Used car prices have risen to their highest point since summer 2023, signaling supply constraints and persistent consumer demand. This inflationary pressure feeds into overall CPI concerns alongside energy shocks, validating Fed inflation warnings.

trends.name: Gold Miners Rally on Pullback Entry Point
trends.summary: GDX (gold miners ETF) pullback creates compelling entry with options market confirming upside bias. Gold is benefiting from geopolitical risk premium and inflation expectations driven by Iran crisis and Fed's higher inflation path.

trends.name: ADP Jobs Print Strongest Since September 2025
trends.summary: ADP employment data showed +26k jobs for week ending March 21st—the strongest weekly print in ADP's brief history. This contradicts durable goods weakness and suggests labor market resilience, creating conflicting signals about economic momentum heading into earnings season.
